messages:
Tara - AE: FYI incoming RFP from NovaBank. They want a short POC but with full regulatory checks: 7yr audit retention, HSM-backed keys, HIPAA + SOC2 evidence. They asked for a 1-line POC estimate + what discounts look like for 12 vs 24 mo. Need a quick feasibility + price note to keep them moving.
Ravi: Technically fine. Options: Dedicated reserved capacity with Redwood-managed HSM integration (we keep keys) or Private deployment (customer BYOK / HSM inside their VPC). For true customer-controlled HSM we need Private.
Liam - Solutions Eng: POC path recommendation: Private eval (VPC) for 14 days to demo HSM flows and key rotation. If they want production-grade HSM (FIPS/HSM appliance), coordinate with infra (procurement + networking) 1-5 business days.
Tara - AE: They pressed for cost tradeoffs: what does extended retention + HSM typically add to the bill?
Evelyn - Deal Desk: High level numbers to use in conversations (pre-approval): HSM service fee (Redwood-managed) $7,500/mo; customer-BYOK integration (one-time) $12k setup. Audit cold storage $0.0025/GB-month. Search/indexed logs (hot) $0.01/GB-month. Onboarding fee usually $15k one-time. Discounts: 12mo -> up to 12% off list, 24mo -> up to 22% off, greater commits escalate to legal for deeper concessions.
Marta - Compliance: Note: HIPAA requires a signed BAA before any PHI is processed. If logs include PHI, we must either ensure customer-managed keys or confirm our controls in the BAA. SOC2 scope extension (to include their instance) is an engagement: budget ~$40k one-time + 6-8 weeks.
Liam - Solutions Eng: Need their ingest numbers to size storage and search. Also confirm whether they need full-text search on logs (adds CPU/index cost) vs cold-only archive.
Tara - AE: Customer supplied rough numbers: ~300k events/day, avg 1.5KB/event. They want 7yr retention and occasional (quarterly) forensic pulls.
Liam - Solutions Eng: Quick math: 300k * 1.5KB = ~450MB/day -> ~13.5GB/month -> ~1,134GB over 84 months (7yrs). Cold storage @ $0.0025/GB-month -> monthly cost = 13.5 * $0.0025 = $0.03375 (~$0.034/month). Over 84 months = 1,134 * $0.0025 = $2.835 total storage cost across 7yrs. So storage itself is tiny. Index/search and retrieval/ops are the expensive parts.
Evelyn - Deal Desk: Exactly. Primary costs: HSM fees, one-time integration, SOC2 scope extension, and any egress/export support for audits. For quoting: assume HSM-managed $7.5k/mo + $12k setup if BYOK required. If they sign 12mo reserved at estimated ARR $240k we could offer 15% off and waive up to $5k of onboarding for the POC. For a 24mo commit at $480k ARR, offer 25% off and waive $12k of onboarding subject to legal sign-off.
Marta - Compliance: Also flag retention access SLA: if they need searchable logs with sub-hour query SLA that becomes a separate SLA item and potential penalty. Add "forensics export window" and "redaction requirement" questions to the questionnaire.
Tara - AE: They asked about a POC fee waiver for the HSM setup. Can we grant a full waiver for the POC period?
Evelyn - Deal Desk: We can approve up to $5k onboarding waiver for POC without exec review. Anything beyond that needs finance sign-off. One-off waiver for HSM setup for a short demo usually limited because infra incurs cost.
InfraBot: POC provisioning request received  ticket#POC-9402 assigned to eng-infra. Estimated provisioning time: 48h for Private eval (no production HSM).
Liam - Solutions Eng: Next steps for quote: 1) confirm ingest cadence and whether logs include PHI 2) decide Private vs Dedicated 3) choose search vs archive 4) include SOC2 extension line if requested 5) record commit level for discount. I'll draft a sizing worksheet.
Tara - AE: I'll send their questionnaire and ask them to confirm PHI presence + whether they require customer-controlled HSM. Tagging Evelyn for deal numbers.
Evelyn - Deal Desk: Once Tara uploads projected ARR and confirms mode, I'll create the deal desk ticket and propose provisional pricing per above. We'll request legal to prepare the BAA template.
Marta - Compliance: I'll prepare a HIPAA checklist and a short doc on log redaction options to attach to the POC.
Tara - AE: Great  thanks all. I'll update NovaBank with a single-line POC estimate: "Private POC + compliance add-ons ~ $9k/mo (HSM) + minimal cold storage; onboarding fees subject to waiver; final quote after sizing and commitment."
Liam - Solutions Eng: That single-line is fine for now but mark as provisional. We'll follow up with exact ARR-based discount scenarios.
